Title: Five more free services now available in the Azure free account

Body.Content:
Get started with newly added free amounts of Service Bus, VPN Gateway, Load Balancer, Container Registry, Archive Storage, as well as increased free amounts of Cosmos DB are now available for eligible Azure free account users. These are offered as part of the 12 months free services when users sign up for an Azure free account. See what you can build with these new additions.

Sign up and get started here.
